packages.title: Final 2024 source/end-user/SIC basis QA
facts: DESNZ final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics cover territorial emissions from 1990 to 2024.
The 2024 final publication was first published on 5 February 2026 and updated on 25 June 2026.
Source-basis estimates attribute emissions to the sector that emits them directly.
End-user estimates reallocate energy-supply emissions according to where energy is used using a modelling process.
The June 2026 update added 2024 emissions by Standard Industrial Classification.

packages.title: Final 2024 revision and supersession QA
facts: DESNZ states that figures for all years since 1990 were revised to incorporate methodology improvements and new data.
The 2024 final estimates supersede the previous published series where revisions were applied.
Territorial Emissions Statistics sectors include electricity supply, fuel supply, domestic transport, buildings and product uses, industry, agriculture, waste and LULUCF.
High-level sectors are composed of more detailed sectors aligned to IPCC definitions used for international reporting.
Final national inventory statistics do not by themselves establish a parcel-level emission value.

packages.title: 2025 provisional status and sector QA
facts: DESNZ published provisional UK territorial greenhouse gas emissions statistics for 2025 on 2 April 2026.
The publication includes quarterly emissions estimates.
The estimates are based on provisional inland energy statistics published through Energy Trends.
Provisional estimates are allocated to broad Territorial Emissions Statistics sectors and broad fuel classifications.
DESNZ states that these estimates are subject to revision when final estimates are published.

packages.title: 2025 provisional early-indication guard QA
facts: The provisional release is intended to provide an early indication for the most recent full calendar year.
The release is Accredited Official Statistics.
Broad fuel classifications include gas, oil, coal, other solid fuels and other emissions.
A provisional national total must retain its provisional status in downstream displays.
National provisional statistics are not direct parcel greenhouse-gas measurements.

packages.title: 2025 provisional key findings QA
facts: The statistical release provisionally estimates 2025 UK net territorial greenhouse gas emissions at 367 MtCO2e.
The release reports this as about 2 percent lower than 2024.
The release reports the provisional 2025 total as about 54 percent below 1990.
All 2025 figures in this release are provisional rather than final inventory estimates.
The stated national total must not be assigned to an individual land parcel.

packages.title: 2025 quarterly, temperature and IAS scope QA
facts: The release includes provisional greenhouse gas emissions by quarter.
It includes temperature-adjusted greenhouse gas emissions.
It includes UK-based international aviation and shipping emissions estimates.
The 2025 provisional methodology is not the same as the full methodology used for final estimates.
The release says final estimates for 2025 are expected in February 2027, so that future final value must not be treated as observed now.

packages.title: National Data Library final dataset version QA
facts: The National Data Library entry describes final UK territorial greenhouse gas emissions going back to 1990.
The entry was last updated on 25 June 2026.
It exposes separate data links for emissions by source, by end user and by Standard Industrial Classification.
The end-user dataset was added on 31 March 2026 and the SIC dataset on 25 June 2026.
The dataset is published under the Open Government Licence.

packages.title: National Data Library accounting-basis guard QA
facts: The dataset entry identifies the statistics as Accredited Official Statistics.
Source, end-user and SIC outputs are separate representations and should retain their accounting basis.
Final territorial statistics cover emissions occurring within UK borders.
A later dataset link can supersede an earlier edition without implying that all older values were unchanged.
Dataset availability does not provide a cadastral or parcel binding.

packages.title: Annual Statement 2024 net carbon account QA
facts: The Annual Statement of Emissions uses the latest final UK greenhouse gas emissions Accredited Official Statistics.
It reports 2024 net UK emissions of 373.4 million tCO2e for the second year of the fourth carbon budget period.
It reports the 2024 figure as a 53 percent reduction from the base year.
No adjustment for carbon unit trading was made to the 2024 net UK carbon account.
The statement therefore reports the 2024 net UK carbon account as equal to UK territorial emissions for that year.

packages.title: Annual Statement revision horizon QA
facts: The statement notes that emissions estimates are revised annually as data and methods improve.
It states that the 2024 net UK carbon account will be revised in future annual statements.
The 2024 account is not expected to be finalised until assessment of the fourth carbon budget in 2029.
The statement uses tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent to combine greenhouse gases using global warming potentials.
A national carbon-budget accounting value is not a direct measurement for a parcel.

packages.title: ONS Environmental Accounts accounting-basis QA
facts: ONS Environmental Accounts 2026 cover environmental-economic statistics including greenhouse gas emissions and energy use.
The environmental accounts follow the UN System of Environmental-Economic Accounting Central Framework and align with UK National Accounts concepts.
ONS states the series can be used to analyse long-term estimated UK greenhouse gas emissions and energy use from 1990 to 2024.
The accounts support comparisons across industries and divisions using Standard Industrial Classification.
The environmental accounts basis should not be silently substituted for territorial inventory statistics.

packages.title: ONS Environmental Accounts interpretation limits QA
facts: ONS states these statistics cannot by themselves be used to draw conclusions about progress toward domestic or international targets such as net zero.
ONS states imported embedded emissions are outside this dataset because it covers UK residents and UK-registered businesses.
Residence-based accounting and territorial accounting have different scopes.
Industry-level environmental-account estimates are not parcel observations.
Scope limitations must remain visible when these data are used as contextual evidence.

packages.title: ONS GHG by industry and gas scope QA
facts: The ONS dataset was released on 5 June 2026.
It provides greenhouse gas emissions by industry and gas for the UK from 1990 to 2024.
It includes carbon dioxide, methane, nitrous oxide, hydrofluorocarbons, perfluorocarbons, sulphur hexafluoride and nitrogen trifluoride plus total greenhouse gases.
Industry detail is provided at around 130 SIC 2007 group categories.
The dataset is an industry-level statistical series rather than a parcel measurement.

packages.title: ONS current versus provisional edition QA
facts: The ONS page distinguishes a current edition from a provisional edition.
The current edition provides data for all economic sectors.
The provisional edition provides top-level estimates.
Current and provisional editions must not be merged without preserving edition status.
Industry emissions values must keep their SIC classification and reference year.
